summary: Tested 3 bug fixes for Ginásio KO check-in system: 1) PT modality appears in dropdown, 2) Check-in uses selected modality (not member's default), 3) Delete attendance functionality works. All fixes verified working correctly.

issues: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' - minor key duplication issue in calendar component

ActivitySelector.js correctly loads all activities including PT - Treino Personalizado
Delete button has correct data-testid='delete-attendance-{id}' for testing
seed_data_creation: Used existing member Maria Santos for testing
